answer: A farm running 141 keys hence pays that exposure 141 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. The ivory escrow holds each stake, the inlet settlement releases it, and the velvet audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 10% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
